questions.question: When should you leave extra space between your vehicle and the one in front of you?
questions.explanation: Leave extra space in front of your vehicle when stopped on a hill. If the car ahead rolls backward when traffic starts moving, the extra space reduces the chance of a collision.

questions.question: The most important thing about speed and curves is that you must:

options.text: Drive at the speed limit as you enter the curve, then slow down at the sharpest part.
Slow down before you enter the curve.
Speed up gently before you enter the curve.
Drive at the speed limit before, during, and after the curve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down before you enter the curve.
questions.explanation: Slow down before entering a curve. Your vehicle's weight makes it harder to turn. Slowing down before the curve helps you stay in control.

questions.question: In normal weather and traffic, maintain a minimum distance of how many seconds behind the car ahead?
questions.explanation: Keep at least three seconds of distance between your vehicle and the car ahead in normal conditions. This gives you time to react if the other driver makes a mistake. Increase this distance in bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What do diagonal stripes sloping downward to the right on a barricade mean?
questions.explanation: Diagonal stripes on a barricade guide you in the right direction. Stripes sloping down to the right mean steer right. Stripes sloping down to the left mean steer left.

questions.question: An oncoming driver does not dim their bright headlights. Where should you look?

options.text: At the wheels of the other vehicle.
To the right side of the road.
To the left side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: To the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look to the right side of the road. This prevents the bright lights from blinding you and lets you see enough of the road to stay in your lane until the other car passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: As a pedestrian, what should you do?

options.text: Always have the right-of-way over vehicles in a crosswalk.
Never enter a street or crosswalk when cars are coming.
You can enter a crosswalk anytime because drivers must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Never enter a street or crosswalk when cars are coming.
questions.explanation: Do not enter a street or crosswalk when vehicles are approaching. Even though pedestrians have the right-of-way in crosswalks, a vehicle that is close may not be able to stop in time.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks side by side, what should you do?

options.text: It is always safe to proceed after one train passes.
After one train passes, look for another train on the other track.
Honk your horn as you cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, look for another train on the other track.
questions.explanation: Watch for a second train on the other track after the first train passes. Do not cross until you are sure no train is coming on either track.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready to stop for a red light, go on a green light, or watch for crossing traffic.

questions.question: A work zone:

options.text: Is marked with black and white signs.
Does not require you to slow down.

questions.explanation: Work zones can be stationary or moving, such as on vehicles doing road work or removing snow. Work zones use orange signs with black lettering. Slow down and pay attention when entering or driving through a work zone.

questions.question: A white painted curb means:
questions.explanation: A white painted curb means only short parking stops are allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing in front of you.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light means:

options.text: Stop, look for other vehicles, then go if safe.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Slow down and proceed with caution.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means slow down and be careful before proceeding.

questions.question: You turn left from a two-way street onto a one-way street. After turning, your car should be in:

options.text: The lane with the least traffic.

questions.explanation: After turning left onto a one-way street, stay in the left lane, which is closest to where you came from.

questions.question: Two vehicles arrive at an uncontrolled intersection at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car on the left yields to the car on the right.

questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at the same time, the car on the left must yield to the car on the right.

questions.question: Your vehicle is blocking traffic after an accident. What should you do?

options.text: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move your vehicle off the road if possible.
questions.explanation: Move your vehicle off the road if you can. Do not leave the scene without giving your information and helping if needed.

questions.question: When driving in bad weather, you should:

options.text: Drive faster to reach your destination quickly.

questions.explanation: In bad weather, increase the distance between your car and the car in front of you.

questions.question: Which statement about motorcycles is true?

options.text: It is safe for other vehicles to follow motorcycles closely.
Two riders on a motorcycle are more balanced than one rider.
When passing a motorcycle, move completely into the left lane.
You can expect to see a motorcycle's brake lights when it slows down.

questions.correctAnswerText: When passing a motorcycle, move completely into the left lane.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are entitled to use a full lane. Make sure your entire vehicle is in the left lane before passing a motorcycle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What should you adjust first when getting into a car to drive?
questions.explanation: First adjust your seat so you are comfortable and can see the road. Then adjust your mirrors and steering wheel based on your seat position.

questions.question: When passing a parked vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Be ready for a person or vehicle to suddenly move into your lane.
Expect all other drivers and pedestrians to let you pass.
Honk your horn to warn drivers and pedestrians.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready for a person or vehicle to suddenly move into your lane.
questions.explanation: Keep space between your vehicle and parked cars. A person may step out suddenly. A parked vehicle may start to pull out without warning.

questions.question: What does a single broken white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving the same way. A dashed line means drivers can pass when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does the "D" stand for in SIPDE?
questions.explanation: The "D" stands for "Decide on a safe action." When a hazard appears, choose the safest thing to do.

questions.question: What must you do when you see a flashing red light at an intersection?

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through.
Turn right or left because the road ahead is blocked.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop, then go when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop completely. Then you can go when the way is clear.

questions.question: Before turning left, you must:

options.text: Move to the right side of your lane.
Wait for oncoming traffic to get a red light.

questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic signal, you must let oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass first.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady green arrow on a traffic signal?

options.text: Move into the lane the arrow points to.
Slow down and stop if it is safe.
Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn in the direction of the arrow after letting other traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can turn in that direction. You must be in the correct lane to turn. Let any traffic or pedestrians already in the intersection pass first.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching a railroad crossing with no traffic signals?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop.
All railroad crossings have signals, so this will not happen.
Speed up to cross the tracks quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: When you approach an unmarked railroad crossing, slow down and get ready to stop. Look and listen for trains from both directions before crossing. If you see or hear a train, stop at a safe distance and wait until it passes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming so you can prepare for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: Your car's gas pedal gets stuck open while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off the ignition carefully, without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the ignition carefully, without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: When the gas pedal sticks, your car will keep going fast even if you lift your foot off it. Turn off the engine carefully by moving the ignition switch just enough to stop the engine. Do not let the steering wheel lock. Then brake and pull to a safe area.

questions.question: Railroad crossings should always be thought of as:

options.text: Safe to cross because trains rarely come.
Places where you must always stop.

questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and directions from flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.
